AccountClient and account scope

Bind requests, controllers and message operations to one account.

Choose an account

AccountClient(account) binds to the authorized login generation. get_client() uses the callback account when present and otherwise uses the selected account. account_scope(account) temporarily changes the implicit account used by module helpers.

Controller and message methods

The bound client exposes Telegram controllers, storage, file loader, notification center and user config. Use send_request(request, fn), send_message(params, parse_mode), send_text, send_photo, send_document, send_video, send_audio and edit_message. Java host methods recheck account identity before sensitive operations.
